ledger_entries_one_original_charge_per_l.name: ledger_entries_one_original_charge_per_line
ledger_entries_one_original_charge_per_l.where: "ledger_entries"."type" = 'CHARGE' AND "ledger_entries"."rebook_of" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."coverage_line_id" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_rebook_has_days.name: ledger_entries_rebook_has_days
ledger_entries_rebook_has_days.value: "ledger_entries"."rebook_of" IS NULL OR "ledger_entries"."days_in_effect" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_charge_shape.name: ledger_entries_charge_shape
ledger_entries_charge_shape.value:
"ledger_entries"."type" <> 'CHARGE' OR ("ledger_entries"."amount_cents" >= 0 AND "ledger_entries"."effective_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."premium_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."premium_cents" > 0
        AND "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."charge_id" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."payment_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."stripe_refund_id" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_days_shape.name: ledger_entries_days_shape
ledger_entries_days_shape.value:
("ledger_entries"."days_in_effect" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."days_in_term" IS NULL)
        OR ("ledger_entries"."type" = 'CHARGE' AND "ledger_entries"."days_in_term" IN (365, 366)
            AND "ledger_entries"."days_in_effect" >= 1 AND "ledger_entries"."days_in_effect" <= "ledger_entries"."days_in_term")

ledger_entries_reversal_shape.name: ledger_entries_reversal_shape
ledger_entries_reversal_shape.value:
"ledger_entries"."type" <> 'REVERSAL' OR ("ledger_entries"."amount_cents" <= 0 AND "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."effective_date" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."premium_cents" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."rebook_of" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."coverage_line_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."charge_id" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."payment_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."stripe_refund_id" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_credit_shape.name: ledger_entries_credit_shape
ledger_entries_credit_shape.value:
"ledger_entries"."type" <> 'CREDIT' OR ("ledger_entries"."amount_cents" < 0 AND "ledger_entries"."charge_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."effective_date" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."premium_cents" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."rebook_of" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."coverage_line_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."payment_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."stripe_refund_id" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_payment_shape.name: ledger_entries_payment_shape
ledger_entries_payment_shape.value:
"ledger_entries"."type" <> 'PAYMENT' OR ("ledger_entries"."amount_cents" < 0 AND "ledger_entries"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."effective_date" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."premium_cents" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."rebook_of" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."coverage_line_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."charge_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."stripe_refund_id" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_refund_shape.name: ledger_entries_refund_shape
ledger_entries_refund_shape.value:
"ledger_entries"."type" <> 'REFUND' OR ("ledger_entries"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "ledger_entries"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."stripe_refund_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."effective_date" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."premium_cents" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."rebook_of" IS NULL
        AND "ledger_entries"."coverage_line_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."charge_id" IS NULL)

policies_cancel_shape.name: policies_cancel_shape
policies_cancel_shape.value:
("policies"."status" = 'active' AND "policies"."cancel_date" IS NULL AND "policies"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("policies"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "policies"."cancel_date" IS NOT NULL AND "policies"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL
            AND btrim("policies"."cancel_reason") <> ''
            AND "policies"."cancel_date" >= "policies"."term_start" AND "policies"."cancel_date" < "policies"."term_end")

stripe_events_reason_iff_ignored.name: stripe_events_reason_iff_ignored
stripe_events_reason_iff_ignored.value:
("stripe_events"."outcome" = 'ignored' AND "stripe_events"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("stripe_events"."reason") <> '')
        OR ("stripe_events"."outcome" = 'recorded' AND "stripe_events"."reason" IS NULL)
